text:
Lina Gomez: Heads-up: noticed inconsistent padding + focus styling between the compact action in the Resource table and the primary in the Config modal. also the toast briefly covers the row action on narrow widths.

Theo Barnes: saw that in mobile QA. looks like table uses legacy `btn-compact` tokens.

Ivy Park: yep token drift. modal uses `--rwd-button-padding` while table is using older `--rwd-legacy-pad-small`.

Ravi: repro: Console -> Resources -> hover row -> Actions menu open -> trigger save to show toast. On 360px width the toast slides in and overlaps the menu for 150-200ms.

Lina Gomez: attaching quick GIF. the focus ring also appears thinner in table actions when tabbing. feels off for keyboard users.

Theo Barnes: code snippet from storybook:
```css
.btn { padding: var(--rwd-button-padding); border-radius: var(--rwd-radius-1); }
.table .row-action .btn { padding: var(--rwd-legacy-pad-small); }
.toast { bottom: 12px; left: 12px; transform: translateY(8px); transition: transform 240ms; }
.modal .footer .btn { padding-inline: var(--rwd-button-padding); }
```

Ivy Park: suggestions:
- replace `--rwd-legacy-pad-small` with `--rwd-button-inline` so its explicit
- add `--rwd-toast-safety-gap` token that components can consume to reserve space
- standardize toast animation to 200ms to match other overlays
- unify focus ring to `--rwd-focus-strong` across table & modal

Ravi: +1 for toast gap token. prefer not to raise z-index. reserving space is more robust for a11y overlays.

Lina Gomez: also copy nit: table action shows "Apply" vs modal shows "Apply changes". recommendation: short label in inline contexts, full label in modals. add guidance to Buttons docs.

Theo Barnes: for a11y, if we increase horizontal padding ensure hit target >= 44px and that focus contrast >= 4.5:1. I'll add an Axe check.

Ivy Park: I'll open a PR to update tokens + add a combined story (table + modal + toast) so visual-regression catches the interaction. Will include migration note in tokens.md.

DesignBot: Preview build for PR #4399 created (visual-regression + a11y).

Ravi: one extra tiny nit: table row actions use a 2px focus ring offset, modals use 3px. can we standardize to 3px? feels more consistent and easier to target.

Lina Gomez: OK let's standardize to 3px and document it. assigning Ivy for token changes, Theo for a11y checklist, Ravi to verify animations.

Ivy Park: branch up later today. will ping when preview is ready.

DesignBot: PR #4399 merged to staging. Visual diffs: 3 stories updated. a11y-lint: 0 failures, 1 contrast advisory for a subtle UI element assigned to Theo.
